comment: A dwarvish Valkyrie with the time option accepts the tutorial; MSGTYPE=stop "Entering.*" matches the pre-message of allmain.c maybe_do_tutorial() asks options.c ask_do_tutorial() and passes "Entering the tutorial." to do.c schedule_goto() as the pre-message that deferred_goto() prints. pline.c vpline() looks the line up with msgtype_type() and, for MSGTYP_STOP, calls display_nhwindow(WIN_MESSAGE, TRUE) after putmesg(), before the level change.
